title: Corrigendum to the Notification for Health Inspector Grade-II

source.name: Medical Services Recruitment Board (MRB), Tamil Nadu

text:
KEY LINES:
Notification No.06/MRB/2023 Dated: 31.07.2023
No.06/MRB/2023 dated: 11.07.2023, the following instructions are issued:
In the Notification No.06/ MRB / 2023 dated: 11.07.2023, the last
date for online application was fixed as 31.07.2023. As per directions
28.07.2023, the last date for on-line application is hereby extended
upto 07.08.2023. Consequently the last date for online Registration
and online payment will be 07.08.2023.

FULL TEXT:
GOVERNMENT OF TAMIL NADU
MEDICAL SERVICES RECRUITMENT BOARD (MRB)
7thFloor, DMS Building, 359, Anna Salai,
Teynampet, Chennai-06. Website: www.mrb.tn.gov.in
Email: mrb.tn.nic@gmail.com Phone no: 044-24355757
Notification No.06/MRB/2023 Dated: 31.07.2023
CORRIGENDUM
In partial modification of the detailed Notification
No.06/MRB/2023 dated: 11.07.2023, the following instructions are issued:
In the Notification No.06/ MRB / 2023 dated: 11.07.2023, the last
date for online application was fixed as 31.07.2023. As per directions
of the Hon’ble High Court of Madras in W.P.No.21428 of 2023, dated:
28.07.2023, the last date for on-line application is hereby extended
upto 07.08.2023. Consequently the last date for online Registration
and online payment will be 07.08.2023.
MEMBER SECRETARY
